prompts.near_grip:
Edit ONLY exposed bare hand of this transparent1254x1254 game sleeve sprite. Make ONE near-screen RIGHT HAND naturally GRIPPING A SWORD HILT, as a reusable empty grip hand sprite for attaching a weapon later. BACK OF HAND toward viewer, THUMB on PICTURE RIGHT as in this exact source. Wrist hangs downward along original arm axis. The four fingers wrap naturally around an imaginary narrow cylindrical sword handle running across the palm, roughly LEFT-RIGHT in the image and perpendicular to wrist/forearm. Thumb closes securely over index/middle fingers, a small natural C opening between thumb and index at the upper-right of the curled hand. This is a purposeful sword-hilt grip rather than a loose running fist, but not exaggerated. Do NOT draw any actual sword, handle, stick, accessory, ghost shape or colored guide. The weapon will be separate. Keep sensible anatomy/finger count. Same small hand palm width and wrist joint as source, clean stylized few lines, no realistic fingernails. One sprite only.
